github.description: Official GitHub MCP server for pull requests, issues, workflows, and repository context in Copilot chat.

fetch.description: Test API endpoints directly in chat. Use to verify Open-Meteo, Hebcal, Yahoo Finance, and other dashboard data sources without opening a browser.

filesystem.description: Scoped read/write access to the FamilyDashBoard workspace. Use for reading CHANGELOG.md, test files, and GitHub workflow configs.

gitkraken.description: GitKraken MCP server — git blame, log, diff, branch ops, pull request workflow, and Launchpad issue tracking from Copilot chat.
